text: As the Patriots prepare for Jacksonville, rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas continues his ascent after making impact plays in the first two weeks, with the second-round pick set to start against the Jaguars despite the defensive unit dealing with significant injuries—notably the loss of Dre'Mont Jones and Quintayvious Hutchins to shoulder and knee issues respectively, the latter now on injured reserve. The secondary got a boost with cornerback Carlton Davis III returning to action, while the team elevated safety Mike Brown and defensive tackle Jeremiah Pharms Jr. from the practice squad to shore up depth, though tight end Eli Raridon (thigh) and safety Craig Woodson (shoulder) remain questionable for the Week 3 matchup. Beyond the roster shuffling, the beat writers are noting that Jacksonville's Trevor Lawrence will be facing a Patriots team still in the early stages of self-discovery, a vulnerability compounded by New England's continued struggles with clock management in the second quarter—something the coaching staff has already acknowledged needs improvement before halftime.
